research_question: On the exact frame where mobile QNN metric depth becomes available, does the inherited foot-body-head swept envelope represent physically measured collision intrusion more reliably than ground-only 2D clearance without unsafe UNKNOWN-to-CLEAR conversion?

inherits: the project-owned HFTF body-width swept envelope
fresh QNN depth CameraX tensor path
relationship_to_prior_work.new_evaluation_increment: fresh mobile metric-depth snapshot under independent controlled physical intrusion truth
relationship_to_prior_work.novelty_accounting: HFTF remains the project-owned first contribution; this successor may claim only fresh mobile metric-snapshot evidence and must not double-count HFTF inside the same paper

source.depth_source: existing CameraX same-frame exact QNN metric-depth branch
source.rgb_input: the exact CameraX frame whose tensor produced the bound depth output
source.camera_mount: tripod or head-height rigid mount reset for every parent session
source.intrinsics: hash-bound calibration captured before the formal cohort

physical_truth.support_structure_rule: supports must remain outside every evaluated swept envelope

forbidden_truth: QNN depth used to place or relabel obstacles
Samsung Quick Measure as sole truth

field.interval_semantics: lower inclusive, upper exclusive except head upper inclusive
field.snapshot_validity: exact bound depth output only; no reuse by later RGB frames

cohort.independent_unit: parent capture session after complete mount and scene reset
cohort.frame_role: repeated measurement within session, never an independent experimental unit

arms.B0_GROUND_ONLY_2D: foot-ground clearance and discontinuity only; body/head obstacles cannot be inferred from absent ground evidence
arms.B1_HEIGHT_COLLAPSED_3D: same fresh 3D points and maximum body envelope, predicts any intrusion but no height identity
arms.C1_HEIGHT_STRATIFIED: same fresh 3D points split into inherited foot-body-head swept envelopes

truth_and_unknown.primary_truth: physically measured obstacle prism intersecting the frozen direction-distance-height swept volume
truth_and_unknown.clear_truth: no measured prism intersection and measured flat supported floor for the evaluated volume
truth_and_unknown.unknown_truth: pose, calibration, physical ledger, image quality, depth support, or ground support is insufficient
truth_and_unknown.manual_review: geometry ledger verification only; reviewers cannot view arm outputs

metrics: false-clear frame count and parent-session event count
cell and parent-session macro known coverage
execution_rules: Implement and test the source validator and evaluator on analytic fixtures before collecting the formal cohort.
Seal physical truth and source hashes before reading any arm output.
Do not change roster, height bands, envelope widths, thresholds, truth, gates, or aggregation after any formal QNN output is opened.
Report session-macro and worst-session metrics; do not promote frame-micro results.
Any missing scenario class or opportunity returns NOT_EVALUABLE rather than pass.
A supported result authorizes only a separately frozen periodic metric anchor utility protocol.
claim_ceiling: controlled fresh-snapshot Development evidence only; no temporal persistence, user event, alert, navigation, production, or safety authority
